# extraction and preparation of data
extract_alpha_data <- function(phylo_obj, marker_name) {
  alpha <- estimate_richness(phylo_obj, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon")) %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    left_join(as(sample_data(phylo_obj), "data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"), by = "SampleID")

  # --- Pielou's evenness: J = Shannon / ln(S) ---
  alpha$Pielou <- with(alpha, ifelse(Observed > 1 & !is.na(Shannon),
                                     Shannon / log(Observed), NA_real_))

  alpha$Marker <- marker_name

  otu <- as(otu_table(phylo_obj), "matrix")
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phylo_obj))

  otu_host <- sapply(unique(meta$HostSpecies), function(hs) {
    samples <- rownames(meta[meta$HostSpecies == hs, ])
    rowSums(otu[, samples, drop = FALSE]) > 0
  })

  otu_loc <- sapply(unique(meta$Locality), function(loc) {
    samples <- rownames(meta[meta$Locality == loc, ])
    rowSums(otu[, samples, drop = FALSE]) > 0
  })

  otu_count_host <- data.frame(
    HostSpecies = colnames(otu_host),
    OTU_Count = colSums(otu_host),
    Marker = marker_name
  )

  otu_count_loc <- data.frame(
    Locality = colnames(otu_loc),
    OTU_Count = colSums(otu_loc),
    Marker = marker_name
  )

  alpha <- left_join(alpha, otu_count_host, by = c("HostSpecies", "Marker"))
  alpha <- left_join(alpha, otu_count_loc, by = c("Locality", "Marker"), suffix = c("", ".loc"))

  return(alpha)
}

# === Import & extraction ===
phy16S <- readRDS("Clean_phyloseq_16S.rds")
phyOL4 <- readRDS("Clean_phyloseq_OL4.rds")

alpha_all <- bind_rows(
  extract_alpha_data(phy16S, "16S"),
  extract_alpha_data(phyOL4, "ITS")
)

# === Keep all hostspecies, but mark ones with n<2 ===
host_counts <- alpha_all %>%
  dplyr::count(Marker, HostSpecies, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Keep = n >= 2,
    HostLabel = paste0("italic('", HostSpecies, "')~'(n=", n, ")'")
  )

alpha_host <- alpha_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = c("Marker", "HostSpecies"))

# === Order of HostLabel : calculated on valid HostSpecies (Keep==TRUE), and add other at the end ===
host_order_df <- alpha_host %>%
  dplyr::filter(Keep) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(HostLabel, Category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(Observed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(factor(Category, levels = c("Invasive", "Native")), med)

extra_levels <- setdiff(unique(alpha_host$HostLabel), host_order_df$HostLabel)

alpha_host$HostLabel <- factor(
  alpha_host$HostLabel,
  levels = c(host_order_df$HostLabel, extra_levels)
)

# === LOCALITY : add information to label (n=) and order it ===
loc_counts <- alpha_all %>%
  dplyr::count(Locality, Marker, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LocalityLabel = paste0(Locality, " (n=", n, ")"))

alpha_all <- alpha_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(loc_counts[, c("Locality", "Marker", "LocalityLabel")],
                   by = c("Locality", "Marker"))

alpha_all$LocalityLabel <- factor(
  alpha_all$LocalityLabel,
  levels = alpha_all %>%
    dplyr::group_by(LocalityLabel) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(med = median(Observed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(med) %>%
    dplyr::pull(LocalityLabel)
)

# === Conversion in long format for faceting ===
index_levels <- c("Observed", "Shannon", "Pielou")

alpha_long_host <- alpha_host %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Pielou"),
                      names_to = "DiversityIndex", values_to = "Value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiversityIndex = factor(DiversityIndex, levels = index_levels))

alpha_long_loc <- alpha_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Pielou"),
                      names_to = "DiversityIndex", values_to = "Value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiversityIndex = factor(DiversityIndex, levels = index_levels))

# === Plot A : BY Host ===
plot_facet <- ggplot(alpha_long_host, aes(x = HostLabel, y = Value)) +

  # Low n HostSpecies : grey.
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(alpha_long_host, !Keep),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
    size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7, color = "gray70"
  ) +

  # valid HostSpecies: color Invasive/Native
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(alpha_long_host, Keep),
    aes(color = Category),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.7),
    size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Invasive" = "#7B241C", "Native" = "#22427C")) +
  coord_flip() +

  # Independents Axes by panel
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(Marker ~ DiversityIndex, scales = "free", independent = "x",
                     labeller = labeller(Marker = c("16S" = "Bacteria 16S", "ITS" = "Fungi ITS"))) +

  labs(title = "A",
       y = "Index value (richness / diversity / evenness)",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text = x)) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 25, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
    strip.placement = "inside",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")
  )

ggsave("alpha_diversity_by_host_combined.pdf", plot_facet, width = 16, height = 10)

# === Plot B : By LocalitY ===
plot_facet_loc <- ggplot(alpha_long_loc, aes(x = LocalityLabel, y = Value)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8, color = "gray40") +
  coord_flip() +

  # Independents Axes by panel
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(Marker ~ DiversityIndex, scales = "free", independent = "x",
                     labeller = labeller(Marker = c("16S" = "Bacteria 16S", "ITS" = "Fungi ITS"))) +

  labs(title = "B",
       y = "Index value (richness / diversity / evenness)",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 25, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
    strip.placement = "inside"
  )

ggsave("alpha_diversity_by_locality_combined.pdf", plot_facet_loc, width = 16, height = 10)


# === Merged graph ===
final_plot <- plot_facet / plot_facet_loc +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.5))

ggsave("alpha_diversity.pdf", final_plot, width = 10, height = 10)


# =============================================================================
#  Bubble graph (MEDIAN) : 1 bubble per HostSpecies × Locality
#  + Locality order: Cayenne, Kaw, Bélizon, Nouragues
#  + Host order (by label base-name): 
#      "D. melanogaster, Bipectinata complex sp., Willistoni sp., D. paulistorum,
#       D. sturtevanti, Saltans sp."
#  + Keep facet scales = "free"
#  + 16S: melanogaster points in grey (not in legend)
#  + Axis labels:
#       Host: "Host (n=...)"
#       Locality: "Locality"   <-- NO EFFECTIFS
#  + No axis titles (x/y)
# =============================================================================

# ---- Locality order requested ----
locality_order <- c("Cayenne", "Kaw", "Bélizon", "Nouragues")

# ---- Desired host order (base names, without (n=...)) ----
host_base_order <- c(
  "D. melanogaster",
  "Bipectinata complex sp.",
  "Willistoni sp.",
  "D. paulistorum",
  "D. sturtevanti",
  "Saltans sp."
)

# ---- Counts for axis labels (PER MARKER) ----
host_n_df <- alpha_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(HostSpecies)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(HostSpecies_clean = trimws(as.character(HostSpecies))) %>%
  dplyr::count(Marker, HostSpecies_clean, name = "n_host")

loc_n_df <- alpha_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Locality)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Locality_clean = trimws(as.character(Locality))) %>%
  dplyr::count(Marker, Locality_clean, name = "n_loc")

# ---- Build median table ----
alpha_bubble_med <- alpha_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Pielou"),
    names_to = "DiversityIndex",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(HostSpecies),
    !is.na(Locality),
    !is.na(Value),
    !is.na(Category)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HostSpecies_clean = trimws(as.character(HostSpecies)),
    Locality_clean    = trimws(as.character(Locality)),
    IsDmel            = grepl("melanogaster", HostSpecies_clean, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Marker,
    DiversityIndex,
    HostSpecies_clean,
    Locality_clean,
    Category,
    IsDmel
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    MedianValue = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(host_n_df, by = c("Marker", "HostSpecies_clean")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HostLabel     = paste0(HostSpecies_clean, " (n=", n_host, ")"),
    LocalityLabel = Locality_clean
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Marker = factor(Marker, levels = c("16S", "ITS")),
    DiversityIndex = factor(DiversityIndex, levels = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Pielou")),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Native", "Invasive")),
    Locality_clean = factor(Locality_clean, levels = locality_order)
  )

# ---- Force X labels order PER MARKER (NO effectifs now) ----
locality_levels_labels_16S <- locality_order
locality_levels_labels_ITS <- locality_order

# ---- Force Y host labels PER MARKER using requested order ----
host_levels_labels_16S <- host_n_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Marker == "16S", HostSpecies_clean %in% host_base_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HostSpecies_clean = factor(HostSpecies_clean, levels = host_base_order),
    HostLabel = paste0(HostSpecies_clean, " (n=", n_host, ")")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(HostSpecies_clean) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HostLabel)

host_levels_labels_ITS <- host_n_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Marker == "ITS", HostSpecies_clean %in% host_base_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HostSpecies_clean = factor(HostSpecies_clean, levels = host_base_order),
    HostLabel = paste0(HostSpecies_clean, " (n=", n_host, ")")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(HostSpecies_clean) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HostLabel)

# ---- Add extra hosts (if any) ----
extra_hosts_16S <- alpha_bubble_med %>%
  dplyr::filter(Marker == "16S") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(HostSpecies_clean, HostLabel) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(HostSpecies_clean %in% host_base_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(HostSpecies_clean) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HostLabel)

extra_hosts_ITS <- alpha_bubble_med %>%
  dplyr::filter(Marker == "ITS") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(HostSpecies_clean, HostLabel) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(HostSpecies_clean %in% host_base_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(HostSpecies_clean) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HostLabel)

host_levels_labels_16S <- c(host_levels_labels_16S, extra_hosts_16S)
host_levels_labels_ITS <- c(host_levels_labels_ITS, extra_hosts_ITS)

# ---- Apply marker-specific label factors ----
alpha_bubble_med <- alpha_bubble_med %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HostLabel = dplyr::case_when(
      Marker == "16S" ~ factor(as.character(HostLabel), levels = host_levels_labels_16S),
      Marker == "ITS" ~ factor(as.character(HostLabel), levels = host_levels_labels_ITS),
      TRUE ~ factor(as.character(HostLabel))
    ),
    LocalityLabel = dplyr::case_when(
      Marker == "16S" ~ factor(LocalityLabel, levels = locality_levels_labels_16S),
      Marker == "ITS" ~ factor(LocalityLabel, levels = locality_levels_labels_ITS),
      TRUE ~ factor(LocalityLabel)
    )
  )

# ---- Bubble plot ----
bubble_plot_med <- ggplot(alpha_bubble_med, aes(x = LocalityLabel, y = HostLabel)) +

  # 16S melanogaster in grey (no legend)
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(alpha_bubble_med, Marker == "16S", IsDmel),
    aes(size = MedianValue),
    color = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  # All others colored by Category
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(alpha_bubble_med, !(Marker == "16S" & IsDmel)),
    aes(size = MedianValue, color = Category),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  facet_grid(Marker ~ DiversityIndex, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Native" = "#22427C", "Invasive" = "#7B241C")) +
  guides(size = "none") +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Bubble plot of Alpha diversity median per Host species and Locality",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Category"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black")
  )

ggsave("alpha_diversity_bubble_median.pdf", bubble_plot_med, width = 14, height = 8)



#################################### === Statistiques === ####################################################################
results_stats <- list(Observed = list(), Shannon = list(), Pielou = list())

for (var in c("HostSpecies", "Category", "Locality")) {
  for (marker in c("16S", "ITS")) {
    df <- if (var == "HostSpecies") {
      alpha_host %>% dplyr::filter(Marker == marker)
    } else {
      alpha_all  %>% dplyr::filter(Marker == marker)
    }

    for (measure in c("Observed", "Shannon", "Pielou")) {

      # Clean NA
      df_clean <- df %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(.data[[measure]]))

      # Count effective
      group_counts <- table(df_clean[[var]])
      valid_groups <- names(group_counts[group_counts >= 3])

      # Garder uniquement les groupes avec effectif >= 3
      df_clean <- df_clean %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data[[var]] %in% valid_groups)

      #  Don't test if < 2 groups
      if (length(unique(df_clean[[var]])) < 2) {
        warning(paste("Pas assez de groupes valides pour", var, marker, measure))
        next
      }

      # Convert variable in factor
      df_clean[[var]] <- as.factor(df_clean[[var]])

      # Tests
      kw <- kruskal.test(reformulate(var, measure), data = df_clean)
      pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(df_clean[[measure]], df_clean[[var]], p.adjust.method = "holm")

      # Stock results
      results_stats[[measure]][[var]][[marker]] <- list(kruskal = kw, pairwise = pw)
    }
  }
}

# visualize results
View(results_stats)

######################## Export results ##################################
extract_results_stats <- function(results_stats) {
  all_results <- list()

  for (measure in names(results_stats)) {
    for (var in names(results_stats[[measure]])) {
      for (marker in names(results_stats[[measure]][[var]])) {
        res <- results_stats[[measure]][[var]][[marker]]

        # Kruskal test
        if (!is.null(res$kruskal)) {
          all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            level1 = measure,
            level2 = var,
            level3 = marker,
            test_type = "kruskal",
            group1 = NA,
            group2 = NA,
            p_value = res$kruskal$p.value,
            stat = unname(res$kruskal$statistic),
            df = unname(res$kruskal$parameter),
            method = res$kruskal$method,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }

        # Pairwise Wilcoxon test
        if (!is.null(res$pairwise)) {
          pmat <- res$pairwise$p.value
          if (!is.null(pmat)) {
            for (i in 1:nrow(pmat)) {
              for (j in 1:ncol(pmat)) {
                p <- pmat[i, j]
                if (!is.na(p)) {
                  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
                    level1 = measure,
                    level2 = var,
                    level3 = marker,
                    test_type = "pairwise",
                    group1 = rownames(pmat)[i],
                    group2 = colnames(pmat)[j],
                    p_value = p,
                    stat = NA,
                    df = NA,
                    method = res$pairwise$method,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                  )
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return(do.call(rbind, all_results))
}

# extraction
df_stats <- extract_results_stats(results_stats)

df_stats <- df_stats %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    level3 = dplyr::case_when(
      level3 == "16S" ~ "bacteriome",
      level3 == "ITS" ~ "mycobiome",
      TRUE ~ level3)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group1 = ifelse(is.na(group1), "global", group1),
    group2 = ifelse(is.na(group2), "global", group2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Comparison = paste(group1, group2, sep = " VS ")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-group1, -group2,-stat,-df,-method) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Comparison = ifelse(Comparison == "global VS global", level2, Comparison)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Dataset = paste(level3, "global", sep = " - ")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-level3)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = paste(level1, level2, sep = " ~ ")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-level1,-level2)%>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Term = Comparison,
    Test = test_type,
    `P-value` = p_value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Model, Test, Term, `P-value`, everything())%>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Test = dplyr::case_when(
      Test == "kruskal" ~ "Kruskal-Wallis",
      Test == "pairwise" ~ "Wilcoxon pairwise",
      TRUE ~ Test
    )
  )

# visualize and export to xlsx
View(df_stats)
writexl::write_xlsx(df_stats, "P-values_Alpha_diversity_.xlsx")
